rules.description: AltTab while Cmd+Tab is held: Esc cancels, Cmd+H/J/K/L move (arrow keys), Cmd+W closes / Cmd+Q quits the app of / Cmd+S or Cmd+M minimizes (toggle) the selected window, Cmd+/ searches

to.shell_command: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; touch ~/.cache/yabai-new-window; open -na Ghostty --args -e /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux new -A -s Work
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; touch ~/.cache/yabai-new-window; osascript -e 'tell application "Finder"' -e 'make new Finder window to home' -e 'activate' -e 'end tell'

export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click (first menu bar item of menu bar 1 whose description is "Sound")'

export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click (first menu bar item of menu bar 1 whose description is "Bluetooth")'

export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click (first menu bar item of menu bar 1 whose description starts with "Wi")'   # Wi-Fi menu (its name includes the connection state)

export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "ControlCenter" to click (first menu bar item of menu bar 1 whose description is "Battery")'   # Battery menu
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; ~/.local/bin/yabai-pause   # pause/resume yabai (lets Cmd-drag reach macOS)
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --toggle zoom-parent   # tiled fullscreen: fill its split only
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; ~/.local/bin/window-pop   # pop out: float centered, sticky, on top (again: put back)
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; ~/.local/bin/window-opacity toggle   # Backspace: unfocused windows see-through on/off
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; ~/.local/bin/ws focus recent   # the Space you were on before
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display west; yabai -m display --focus west
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display east; yabai -m display --focus east
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display north; yabai -m display --focus north
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display south; yabai -m display --focus south
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display west; yabai -m display --focus west
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display east; yabai -m display --focus east
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display north; yabai -m display --focus north
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m window --display south; yabai -m display --focus south
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m display --focus next || yabai -m display --focus first
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m display --focus prev || yabai -m display --focus last
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m space --display west; yabai -m display --focus west
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m space --display east; yabai -m display --focus east
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m space --display north; yabai -m display --focus north
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; yabai -m space --display south; yabai -m display --focus south

rules.description: Back/forward on alt+[ / alt+] outside terminals (super+[ / ] do nothing)
Finder like Dolphin: return opens, fn+f2 renames, ctrl+x cuts files, ctrl+l path, ctrl+h hidden files, fn+backspace trash, alt+arrows navigate
Linux-style ctrl shortcuts (ctrl -> cmd) outside terminals
Linux-style text navigation (ctrl+arrows/backspace, home/end) outside terminals
